text:
diane: Heads up - we received a credit note from a marketplace vendor (EdgeMarkets Ltd) for March platform fees. Vendor issued a partial credit of EUR 15,000 on 2025-04-06 referencing Invoice EM-2025-011. Need guidance for March close: reduce revenue, or treat as vendor cost adjustment?
rohit: Quick Q: is this vendor passthrough (we invoice customers and collect) or do we recognize gross and record COGS? That changes treatment.
diane: vendor is marketplace partner where we bill customers gross and pay vendor their share. Contract ref EM-MKT-2020 (section on retroactive adjustments).
keisha: From revrec perspective: if we billed customers gross and revenue recognized in March, any vendor rebate that relates to that March activity should reduce COGS, not revenue. So we should record an accrual reversal or a credit to COGS in March.
mark: Agree but need to check whether vendors expect us to net their credit against future invoices or issue a cash refund. Invoice/credit note snippet below. Also need FX.
```
Credit Note: CN-EM-2025-004
Related Invoice: EM-2025-011 (Service period 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-31)
Credit date: 2025-04-06
Amount: EUR 15,000 (VAT excl)
Vendor stated FX: 1.09 USD/EUR
```
keisha: Per policy use month-end spot FX (2025-03-31 = 1.11 USD/EUR) when attributing to March accruals. EUR15,000 * 1.11 = USD 16,650. Treatment: credit COGS (platform partner payouts) by USD16,650 and reduce Accrued Liabilities by same if accrual exists.
rohit: Do we have an existing accrual for vendor payouts for March? If so we reverse part of it; if not, we book a negative accrual (credit) in March that will flow to P&L. I'll check AP.
diane: AP report shows we had an accrual JE for vendor payouts: JE# 2025-03-1170 accrual USD 200,500. We should reduce that accrual by USD16,650 and reflect the credit.
audit-bot: Reminder: "Binder updated: file added by rohit (EM_credit_calc_Mar2025.xlsx)" :white_check_mark:
rohit: Draft JE: Debit Accrued Liabilities (2115) USD16,650, Credit Hosting COGS (6008) USD16,650. Include a memo: "Vendor credit related to March 2025 marketplace fees; spot FX 2025-03-31 = 1.11."
keisha: Also include contract clause and vendor credit note PDF in binder for audit trail. If vendor nets future invoice instead of cash, we still reflect March P&L impact now and reverse when future invoice nets (clearing entry).
mark: One complexity: Some of the EUR15k credit relates to accounts that were pre-paid by customers (committed bundles). For those customers, vendor credit should reduce deferred vendor payout liability and potentially reduce deferred revenue recognition if we had passed cost through. We need mapping.
diane: I exported mapping of impacted transactions (file uploaded to binder). There are 12 committed bundles impacted. Total of EUR5,200 relates to committed accounts.
rohit: For the EUR5,200 portion (USD 5,200 *1.11 = USD5,772), proposed entries: Debit Accrued Liabilities 5,772, Credit Deferred Vendor Payouts (2520) 5,772. Add memo that this reduces future vendor payout obligation; no immediate revenue impact because customer entitled future service.
keisha: Good. For the remaining EUR9,800 (USD10,878) treat as COGS credit now.
mark: Approval path: Diane can approve up to 25k; this is well under. Diane, please confirm and we'll post JE.
diane: Approved. rohit please post JE adjustments: 1) reduce accrual by USD16,650; 2) reclass EUR5,200 portion to deferred vendor payout (USD5,772) with memo; 3) net USD10,878 to COGS.
rohit: JE posted to GL: JE#2025-03-1256. Files: EM_credit_calc_Mar2025.xlsx, CN-EM-2025-004.pdf, mapping_committed_accounts.csv uploaded to binder.
audit-bot: Note: "Audit package updated: close memo updated with split treatment and FX screenshots" :white_check_mark:
keisha: i'll add a 1-paragraph explanation in the close pack for auditors: rationale for COGS vs deferred treatment, FX choice, contract refs, and approval note.
diane: thanks team. Closing action: keisha to finalize memo, rohit to retain screenshots for payment clearing. Thread resolved for March close. :heavy_check_mark:
